title: Product Catalog Schema Violation Returning String Instead of Float for Price
symptom: Following a microservice refactoring, GET /products returned items where the price field was serialized as a string (e.g. '69.99') instead of a float (69.99), breaking mobile client deserialization.
root_cause: Database query serializer cast decimal column to string without converting to float in the presentation layer.
regression_test_requirement: Every test suite validating GET /products must validate each product item against the OpenAPI JSON Schema, specifically verifying that typeof(price) is numeric (float or int) and >= 0.
